acceptance.given: The Package A completion-gate criteria and Package B handoff table are being evaluated against SM-A25.

oracle.expected: An inspectable completion-gate artifact states that passing the five real Skills through the new standard is not required and that no internal reviewer is enabled; excluded BMAD/GDS/Chapter 2-7 Skills remain excluded.
forbidden: A Package A completion gate requires the five real Skills to pass the new standard.
A Package A completion gate enables or requires an internal reviewer.
Excluded BMAD/GDS/Chapter 2-7 Skills are included in the Package A gate.
oracle.observable: Artifact-level inspection of the Package B handoff/completion-gate criteria and related standard or ADR content during validation.

acceptance.then: The inspected completion-gate artifact preserves the optional Bootstrap Review status, excludes the five real Skills from mandatory new-standard passage, and contains no internal-reviewer enablement mechanism.
acceptance.when: During the structural/document validation phase for the Package A completion gate.

failure_intents.selector_intent: A25 completion-gate artifact inspection detects a requirement or mechanism that enables an internal reviewer or makes the five real Skills mandatory for the new standard.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Document and validate the Package A completion gate so it preserves optional Bootstrap Review status and cannot enable an internal reviewer or require the five real Skills to pass the new standard.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Documentation and index changes are reversible; no runtime state or schema migration is introduced.

slice_hint.state_transition: Completion-gate criteria transition from being defined/evaluated to an explicitly documented gate that excludes mandatory Skill migration and internal-reviewer enablement.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A structural validation of the completion-gate and handoff artifacts finds no internal-reviewer mechanism, no mandatory five-Skill passage requirement, and preserves excluded Skill scope.
